actions.body:
Hello,

This is about VEL-016-26, a refrigerated assay-reagent shipment to Sable Lab, which is segregated under TC16.

Logger LOG-016 (assigned before dispatch; report exported 2026-10-14 08:00 +01:00) shows these readings:
- 06:50–07:10 +01:00: 5 C
- 07:10–07:30 +01:00: 10 C (a continuous 20 minutes above 8 C, which is beyond the 15-minute TC16 threshold)
- 07:30–07:50 +01:00: 5 C
- Arrival probe at 07:50 +01:00: 5 C (recorded separately under TC16)

The full logger report is available to your team. Under TC16, your team alone decides product disposition. Please carry out the assessment and send us the disposition decision so we can record it.

Our receiving contact, Mara Linn, has asked for release. We have not confirmed compliance and have not given any release instruction. The goods stay on hold until your team decides.

Vellora escalation desk
actions.purpose: Send the excursion evidence to the only party allowed to decide disposition and ask for its finding.

actions.subject: VEL-016-26 – release request
actions.body:
Dear Mara,

Thank you for your message. We can't confirm that VEL-016-26 stayed within range, and we can't tell receiving to release it.

The arrival reading was 5 C. However, the shipment's temperature logger shows the shipment was at 10 C from 07:10 to 07:30 (+01:00). Under your lab's TC16 procedure, more than 15 minutes above 8 C means the goods must be held and assessed by your product-safety team. Only that team can decide whether the goods can be used.

We have sent the logger details to quality@sablelab.example and asked them for their assessment. The goods stay on hold until they decide. We can't give you a timescale or an outcome, because that decision is theirs. If you need it sooner, please contact them directly.

Vellora escalation desk
actions.purpose: Decline the request clearly and tell the requester who decides and what happens next.

actions.body: VEL-016-26: LOG-016 shows 20 min at 10 C (07:10–07:30 +01:00), more than the 15-min TC16 threshold. Requester asked to confirm compliance and release. Declined: the desk has no disposition authority. Evidence sent to quality@sablelab.example asking for assessment and disposition. Goods remain segregated. Proof needed: written disposition finding from the product-safety team.
actions.purpose: Record the decline and the open dependency.

not_doing: Not confirming the shipment was compliant: the logger shows an excursion beyond TC16.

Not writing to cold@vellora.example: the logger data is already issued and undisputed, and nothing is needed from the carrier.
input.follow_up: Check the same morning for a disposition finding from quality@sablelab.example (safety queue: immediate follow-up). If the team doesn't respond, pass it to the human supervisor so the hold is not left open. Keep the goods segregated until a written disposition is recorded. If Mara Linn chases with nothing new, hold and do not restate the decline.

input.subject: VEL-016-26 – TC16 temperature excursion: assessment and disposition requested
input.body:
Hello,

This is about VEL-016-26, a refrigerated assay-reagent shipment to Sable Lab, which is segregated under TC16.

Logger LOG-016 (assigned before dispatch; report exported 2026-10-14 08:00 +01:00) shows these readings:
- 06:50–07:10 +01:00: 5 C
- 07:10–07:30 +01:00: 10 C (a continuous 20 minutes above 8 C, which is beyond the 15-minute TC16 threshold)
- 07:30–07:50 +01:00: 5 C
- Arrival probe at 07:50 +01:00: 5 C (recorded separately under TC16)

The full logger report is available to your team. Under TC16, your team alone decides product disposition. Please carry out the assessment and send us the disposition decision so we can record it.

Our receiving contact, Mara Linn, has asked for release. We have not confirmed compliance and have not given any release instruction. The goods stay on hold until your team decides.

Vellora escalation desk

input.subject: VEL-016-26 – release request
input.body:
Dear Mara,

Thank you for your message. We can't confirm that VEL-016-26 stayed within range, and we can't tell receiving to release it.

The arrival reading was 5 C. However, the shipment's temperature logger shows the shipment was at 10 C from 07:10 to 07:30 (+01:00). Under your lab's TC16 procedure, more than 15 minutes above 8 C means the goods must be held and assessed by your product-safety team. Only that team can decide whether the goods can be used.

We have sent the logger details to quality@sablelab.example and asked them for their assessment. The goods stay on hold until they decide. We can't give you a timescale or an outcome, because that decision is theirs. If you need it sooner, please contact them directly.

Vellora escalation desk
